open6_disposition: PARTIALLY CLOSED. The V2 planted-correlation control arm retired V1's strongest objection (boundary/index-shift defects are no longer structurally, mathematically undetectable -- both reviewers independently confirmed they now produce large deviations in the real estimator statistic via the real decode_blocks). But the Red Team's independent measurement of the natural detection rate on realistic content (~8.8 percent, versus the 100 percent this arm's two hand-searched worst-case templates demonstrate) shows the clean MATCH result does not transfer to a calibrated detection rate for the real pipeline. EV-HQC-b71230's PS-R3 measurement still cannot be confidently distinguished from a subtly wrong sampler, though the space of samplers that could produce it undetected is now narrower.
